external_gate.reason: The locked four-episode ALFWorld run and one Coworker normal run both reached their real external runtimes, but neither satisfied the release verifier after the observation contract changed. These failures are preserved and are not reported as release PASS.

alfworld.failure_summary: Episodes 1 and 4 terminated execution_state_uncertain, episode 2 terminated during setup with scan_restore_mismatch before any provider attempt, and episode 3 was score-eligible but not won. The release wrapper also rejected the absent episode-2 provider_attempts.jsonl.

coworker.failure_summary: The real Mimo/browser/service run completed and persisted a verified 255-second H.264 video, but freshness fencing rejected the business actions. No presentation/events.jsonl was produced, so the independent bundle verifier returned 1.

evidence.result: Full Ruff, 12 involved-file format, compileall, upstream/state JSON and git diff checks pass.
